answers.text: REFUSE: No style in the file uses colour #C00000, and colour set on individual words is direct formatting, which this format does not show.
REFUSE: Cell borders are direct formatting on the cells, and this format cannot show or change them.
REFUSE: Patterns cannot be expressed in this format, and cells have no formatting of their own here.
REFUSE: A cell's fill is direct formatting that this format cannot show or change, so the header cells can't be given a grey fill.
REFUSE: Tables and cells have no formatting of their own here, so a grey fill on the new header cells can't be expressed.

REFUSE: The body paragraphs share the default style Normal with the table's cell paragraphs, and new styles and per-paragraph formatting aren't available, so the body can't be indented without also indenting the table.
